messages.content: I'm looking to retrieve the IDs (and context attributes, if any) of files that communicate with domain 'example.net'. Limit the results to 20. My API key is 'apikey_456'.

GET https://api.meraki.com/api/v1/organizations/{organizationId}/file-context?query=...&limit=...

We need to include the API key in the header: X-Cisco-Meraki-API-Key: apikey_456.

We need to specify the organization ID. The user didn't provide organization ID. We need to ask for it. The user only gave API key. We need organization ID. So we should ask for organization ID. Also we need to confirm the query string. The query is "communicates with domain 'example.net'". The query syntax: "communicates with domain example.net". So we need to encode that. The query param should be "communicates%20with%20domain%20example.net". But we can just pass the query string as "communicates with domain example.net". The limit is 20.

Thus we need to ask for organization ID.
